test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A cylinder has curved surface area equal to area of the flat surfaces of the cylinder. If the diameter of the cylinder is r units, then the total surface area of the cylinder (in square units) will be _____.
solution:
**Given:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = Area of the two flat surfaces

Diameter = r ⇒ Radius = r ÷ 2

**Formula used:**

CSA = 2πrh

Area of 2 flat surfaces = 2πr²

Total Surface Area = CSA + 2πr²&
